I posted the draft bullets for June as a reply to your message in #coastal-team, Sofia. Nothing has been sent to June.

The bullets cover four points:
- **Rename:** Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- **PHL clash:** Filtering "PHL" in the morning report now returns both Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics.
- **Old label:** Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- **Ask for June:** Who owns the saved-report relabel, and whether the report filters can use full account names instead of "PHL".

The fourth bullet is my suggestion, not something from your message or Moss's digest. Change or drop it if it isn't what you want to ask June.

Moss's digest is dated 18 May, so I couldn't confirm the report still shows the old label today. You said in February that you'd relabel the saved retail view, so it's worth checking before you send.
